string.name: Title
string.value: Honor Level

string.name: Desc
string.value: Accumulate Honor EXP to increase your character's Honor Level. You will receive a Circulator with each level-up, up to Lv. 31, when you will gain Circulators for earning set amounts of Honor EXP.

string.name: TitleDemon
string.value: Honor Level

string.name: DescDemon
string.value: Accumulate a set amount of Honor EXP to increase your character's Honor Level. You can receive a Circulator which each level-up and can obtain new Inner Ability upon reaching Lv. 2, Lv. 30, and Lv. 70.

string.name: Title
string.value: Honor EXP

string.name: Desc
string.value:
Advance to Warrior, Bowman, Magician, Thief, or Pirate.
Warrior: Level 10 or above. Job NPC Location: Perion
Bowman: Level 10 or above. Job NPC Location: Henesys
Magician: Level 10 or above. Job NPC Location: Ellinia

string.name: TitleDemon
string.value: Honor EXP

string.name: DescDemon
string.value: Shows your current Honor EXP. Once it reaches 100%, your Honor Level will increase. Participate in the Fight for Azwan to obtain Honor EXP.

string.name: Title
string.value: Health Point

string.name: Desc
string.value: You will be incapacitated if your HP reaches 0. Monster attacks, some special skills, and even standing in dangerous areas will decrease your HP. Max HP: 500,000

string.name: TitleDemon
string.value: Health Point

string.name: DescDemon
string.value: You will die when your HP reaches 0. Your HP decreases as you receive damage from monster attacks, use special skills, or stay in special locations. You can raise your HP up to 99,999.

string.name: Title
string.value: Mana Points

string.name: Desc
string.value: Required for many skills. Max: 500,000

string.name: TitleDemon
string.value: Demon Fury

string.name: DescDemon
string.value: Used for all Demon Slayer skills. This stat can only be increased through the use of a Demon Aegis.

string.name: Title
string.value: AP (Ability Point)

string.name: Desc
string.value: Used to increase STR, DEX, INT, LUK, HP, and MP. For STR, DEX, INT, and LUK, every 1 AP used will increase the stat by 1. For HP and MP, the increase will differ based on your character and job. You will receive 5 AP each time you level up.

string.name: TitleDemon
string.value: AP(Ability Point)

string.name: DescDemon
string.value: Used to increase STR, DEX, INT, LUK, HP, and MP. For STR, DEX, INT, and LUK, every 1 AP used will increase the stat by 1. For HP and MP, the increase will differ based on your character and job. You will receive 5 AP each time you level up.

string.name: Desc
string.value: Strength determines the attack strength of Warriors and Pirates (Brawlers) with melee weapons.

string.name: TitleDemon
string.value: Battle EXP

string.name: DescDemon
string.value: Your current Battle EXP. When it reaches 100%, your rank will increase. You can obtain Battle EXP by participating in Battle Mode.

string.name: Desc
string.value: As this stat increases, Accuracy and Avoidability increase. It determines the attack strength of Bowmen and Pirates (Gunslingers).

string.name: Desc
string.value: INT determines the power and success rate of magic attacks. It determines the magic strength and Max MP of Magicians.

string.value: Where the actual Damage is displayed. Magic Attack is displayed when you're equipped with a Wand or Staff, and Weapon Attack is displayed when you're equipped with other weapons.

string.name: Desc
string.value: The sum of additional ATT that's being added to the equipments, skills, abilities, and PvP.

string.name: Title
string.value: Critical Rate

string.name: Desc
string.value: Where Critical Rate is displayed. Average Critical Rate is 5%, and you can enhance it by using skills or items. Critical Damage is minimum 120% and maximum 150%, and can be enhanced by using skills or items.

string.name: Title
string.value: Boss ATT

string.name: Desc
string.value: Inflicts additional damage to the boss monster when attacking.
